verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Fine-grained personal access tokens let you grant a token a defined set of permissions over resources. A community report also confirms protected branches exist as a (paid, for private repos) branch-level control. Nothing documents assigning role-based permissions to people or teams across the hierarchy. missing for 10: documented organization-level roles, project-level permissions, repository role assignment for users/teams, environment-level protection or permission rules, and first-party docs on branch protection permissions.
